Subject: Please provide privacy pack for PO issuance

Hi Anna / FluxWave purchasing team,

We're ready to issue the purchase order to get your integration scheduled, but procurement requires a short privacy/security packet before we can complete PO creation. Please send the following items so Finance and Legal can clear the PO: 

- Fully executed DPA (pdf) or DocuSign signing link
- SOC 2 report (or an access link to the most recent report)
- Current subprocessor inventory (spreadsheet/PDF) and any outstanding subprocessor agreements
- Billing contact and W-9 (or tax equivalent) for invoicing

If you can attach the DPA and subprocessor list directly to your reply, that will speed things up. If anything is delayed on your side, a short status note is fine — we can hold the PO until the docs are confirmed but want to avoid last-minute delays.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
